title: Addition on the constructed complex numbers respects Complex.Equiv on both arguments
statement: For constructed complex numbers x0, x1, x2, x3, if x0 is Complex.Equiv-equivalent to x1 and x2 is Complex.Equiv-equivalent to x3, then x0 + x2 is Complex.Equiv-equivalent to x1 + x3.

formal.statement: theorem Complex.add_congr : ((x0 : Complex) -> ((x1 : Complex) -> ((x2 : Complex) -> ((x3 : Complex) -> ((x4 : Complex.Equiv x0 x1) -> ((x5 : Complex.Equiv x2 x3) -> Complex.Equiv (Complex.add x0 x2) (Complex.add x1 x3)))))))

evidence.supports: Complex.add_congr is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
